name: 青藏沙鴴
illustrationTaxon: Anarhynchus atrifrons adult male in breeding plumage: smaller than Greater Sand-Plover with neater proportions, a less deeply-based bill without a swollen distal half and with a stubbier tip, a smaller eye and shorter legs; broad dark forehead, dark lores, pale orange-buff chest on a clean white ground, clean white flanks with no grey mottling, warmer sandy-brown upperparts than Siberian Sand-Plover. Non-breeding birds have brownish-buff head and chest, pale supercilium, smaller breast patches that do not meet in the centre, clean flanks and relatively longer legs and bill than Siberian. Three subspecies: pamirensis, atrifrons and schaeferi.

similarSpecies.distinction: 體型明顯較大、嘴長而先端腫脹、眼較大、腳較長偏黃、整體較笨重；本種較小較整齊、嘴基較淺而先端較鈍、眼較小、腳較短偏灰。
上體及耳羽較冷較深、脇部有灰色斑駁、胸斑較大片常在中央相接、嘴較粗鈍、腳較短較橄欖色；本種上體較暖較沙、脇部乾淨、胸斑較小不在中央相接、腳較長。

featureNotes: 嘴基部較淺、先端不腫脹而略鈍，是與鐵嘴沙鴴分開的第一個結構特徵（第1圈取自頭部特寫，實際可見）。
繁殖羽前額有一道橫跨的深色帶並穿過眼部，眼後留一塊白斑；這是與蒙古沙鴴較冷較深的頭部羽色分開的重點（第2圈取自頭部特寫，實際可見）。
胸前橙褐色由喉部向下漸淡成白色，脇部乾淨無灰色斑駁；蒙古沙鴴的脇部有灰斑、胸斑亦較大片（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
腳較短而偏灰，脛跗明顯短於鐵嘴沙鴴，腳趾與泥面比例亦不同（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive identification/range/conservation read: Category I scarce winter visitor and passage migrant, mainly Deep Bay intertidal mudflats; separated from Greater Sand-Plover by structure (smaller, neater, less deep-based bill without swollen distal half and with stubbier tip, smaller eye, shorter legs), greyish legs and darker upperparts in most birds, and a more regular stop-start foraging motion; versus Siberian Sand-Plover by warmer paler upperparts and ear coverts, clean flanks without grey mottling, smaller breast patches that do not meet centrally, less bulky body and longer, less olive legs; breeding plumage adults paler and more orange on the chest than Siberian, females paler with ear coverts not darker than the crown; juveniles have a pale forehead blending into the brown crown, warmer covert fringes, cleaner flanks and smaller breast patches; flight call a trilling note very similar to Greater Sand-Plover; southward migration peaks early in July and August with small numbers remaining through winter; breeds on the high plateau north and east of the Himalayas to extreme southern Mongolia and west to the Pamirs as pamirensis, atrifrons and schaeferi; IUCN Least Concern with an unknown population trend.
HKBWS Greater Sand-Plover comparison: larger, longer-legged, longer bill with swollen distal half, larger eye, more ungainly; favours crabs and long waiting dashes.
HKBWS Siberian Sand-Plover comparison: colder darker upperparts and ear coverts, greyish flank mottling, broader breast patches often meeting centrally, thicker stubbier bill, shorter olive legs.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對淺基短嘴、深色前額、橙褐胸帶與灰色短腳；不是照片，也不是分佈或族群證據。
兩隻比較鳥均為 AI 生成示意，非等比例；卡上不作完整鑑別檢索表。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地（青藏高原至帕米爾）與越冬地不分工。
IUCN 無危、趨勢不明；香港屬稀少冬候鳥及春秋過境鳥，主要在后海灣泥灘，秋季南遷高峰在 7–8 月。
